**Discipline: keep the Track H PR/verdict index on #266 CURRENT each slice (comment-based index goes stale; update it with every PR open/merge)**

**What**: The owner caught (3rd reinforcement of the server-visibility discipline) that the canonical Track H PR/verdict index on #266 had gone STALE — it predated #275-#279, and the H1-2C-BASE finding was only in #279's PR body, not on the #266 tracker. Fixed: posted an UPDATED comprehensive index (issuecomment-5004258781) superseding the stale one (4997761144) — the 9 PRs (#269-#279), the 6 durable records (rec-1efa1893, rec-ed1c325e, rec-04902454, rec-7f2e6bab, rec-34a5a5d, rec-f114c218), ADR-0020/0021, the human-decision comment ids, and the open H1-2C-BASE finding + its pending owner decision.

**Root cause + rule**: a comment-based index scrolls and goes stale every slice, so it depends on me remembering to update it. NEW STANDING RULE: update the #266 index whenever a Track H PR opens or merges — as part of the push/PR step, not as an afterthought. The cold reviewer starts from that index to know which PR/issue threads to scan; a stale index means it misses recent surfaces. (Structural alternative to consider: maintain the index in the #266 issue BODY rather than a scrolling comment.)

**This is the 3rd layer of "can the cold reviewer find it"**: (1) server not chat; (2) decisions → .memory/records not plain comments; (3) verdicts/decisions are on multiple surfaces (issue vs PR reviews) → a CURRENT canonical index. All three are now fixed rules. Related: [[track-h/reviewer-verification-inputs]], [[sdd/issue-266-h1-2/apply-progress]].
